author: Angelina Kuzniatsova

title: Best habit tracker
body: Great app overall. I especially like the heatmap-like grid for each habit - it really motivates me. One thing that is missing for me is the possibility to skip a day without completing it. For example if I am tracking something related to work, I would like to skip this habit on public holidays or days off.

title: Simple and effective
body: Great, nice looking and gets the work done. I’d love to have Apple Watch extension but otherwise perfect

title: Rare Gem
body: I feel like these days it is so difficult to find a free app that just does its job without any complications. This app works extremely well. It is simplistic, intuitive and moreover free!

author: Just In X

title: Aesthetic and functional
body: It’s a sleek habit-tracking app that offers customizable goals, streak tracking, and insightful progress charts. I love the minimalist design.
author: Snajper007

title: like Duolingo for habits
body: Fantastic app! I was looking for an app that feels like Duolingo for habits and this is it. Simple, easy to track, reminders help to stay motivated or not forget to log the result. After 3 months of daily use, I’m considering an upgrade to a paid version. Well done, sir.
author: ag-krk

title: Simply the best
body:
10/10 would recommend
I love the simplicity, design, and customizable features. Although free plan is limited to four options I think that’s exactly my number of critical daily habits. But I feel like it’s nice to track more than 4 🙌

I like the haptic feedback of the app and that it’s simple- yet you can adjust the complexity of your habits (how many times per day). 

Would love to see more glyphs/icons in the habit tile- or option to upload yours to make this app more personal.

Nevertheless great app!8

author: Halabala7

title: Awesome app
body:
It’s super helpful to see visualizations of all my habits in monthly and yearly views. No other app implemented visualizations that well. 

I only miss the ability to leave a note to my completions. E.g what exactly did I train in the gym. Also it would be nice for weekly view to include all 7 days not 5. That’s how most people are used to track their weeks. 

Thanks for the good work!

body: So far the best habit tracker I’ve been using. Great presentation layer that really makes the difference for spotting patterns, routines etc. I’m waiting for the Shortcuts integration then I I’ll rate it 6/5
author: Bart KK

title: Simplicity is the best
body: So easy so intuitive and so well-showing the progress that makes my favourite keeping habits app. (Sorry for my previous rating - one star. Of course, the application deserves the maximum number of stars. It's the AppStore design on iPhone that deserves less than one star, as in dark mode there is no significant difference between the grey color - no star and the black star when pressed for rating.)
author: GregQre

title: simple and on point
body: Very simple app to track your habit, can’t wait to see the growth 🙌
author: aliszu

title: The paywall
body:
I like the app but limiting number of habits behind paywall is just not cool. This is not cloud based, it does not produce any costs. And yet you can't have more than 4 habits. Subscription in this case just feels like a theft:) 

I would consider paying for permanent access but not in this state, at least not for that price. There is not enough features in it.
